summary: Every credit-spending sub-call gets its own persisted job row, and every offline search --type filters by the query term.
reason: reconcile joins credit-event remarks against stored prompt IDs, so a billed draw the workflow makes on the user's behalf (the --restore-first pre-pass) reads as an unmatched charge unless it is stored under its own promptId; and a search type that ignores the term returns the whole table while looking like a filtered result.
validated_outcome: Fake-server test asserts the --restore-first pre-pass lands in the jobs table as kind=restore/completed alongside the main draw.
